# The Five Wars: Translated into the Spiritual Sense

** ¶1:** The tru ths born from divine good w aged five successive comb ats against the falsities born from evil . In every combat , the tru ths from good overc ame and subjugated the falsities from evil entirely .

**¶2:** The first combat is that of the Inmost Divine Love, which descended against the ruling falsity governing the hells, and against all the dominant ev ils that had issued from the five genera of evil. He en snared them by the sphere of divine truth, which is the interior life con joined with good. He drew them into the bonds of order. His pure affection for truth, the ard or of divine love itself — they found no means of esc aping the sphere of his truth . He caught them as knowledge - fals ities are caught in the net of spiritual light , according to the five deliber ations corresponding to the five fundamental affections. He sev ered and u prooted the origin of the five false per ceptions — the very root of the inv erted perception of life — as the power of truth se vers what is false at its source .

**¶3:** The second combat is that of the Divine Truth proce eding to establish order. It constructed the heav enly states and the degrees of wisdom ; it extended the dominant falsities out ward and bound them fast within the arrangement of divine law . The kn owledges of truth were set in their places within the interior mind , and the natural states were disposed into the three containing degrees of the mind — celest ial, spiritual, and natural. For the dominant falsities rose up and set themselves against the Divine Order . They wished to resist , for they perceived and recognized that it would bind and fetter them by an un breakable law . Yet the Divine Truth appeared to them in all its forms, with inn umerable modes of proce eding, with omn ipot ent power and ir resistible severity . It was revealed to them; it imprisoned them by the wisdom of divine arrangement . Not one fals ity was able to preserve itself, and all were brought into subj ection. Because it encompasses all things, it captured them entirely .

**¶4:** The third combat is that of the Divine Truth revealing its own form to what lies in the external and natural mind. It drew forth all wisdom and every interior possession of good . That which had been consumed by the domin ion of evil — all the apparent glory that fals ity had claimed from the light of truth — it extended and recovered . A power comes which is m ightier than self -intelligence; it strips away the assumed kn owledges, the rational truths claimed as one 's own, the pride and the de light of self-derived understanding .

**¶5:** This is the nature of the domin ion of evil: it claims all kn owledges as its own as they pass through states of the mind toward the light of wisdom . Yet the Divine Truth cle ansed and purified every truth from the evil that had appropri ated it.

**¶6:** The fourth combat is that which the Lord as Divine Wisdom glorified w aged against all the rebell ious falsities that had risen in both the interior and the exterior degrees of the mind. When wisdom had been separated from them by the revealed form of the Divine Truth , their bonds of restra int were loosened and they broke forth openly . The Glor ified Divine Wisdom, in this fourth combat, came and brought this open rebellion of the entire domin ion of evil to its crisis . He girded himself with power and confront ed the whole of it a second time. He re -established the entire order of heaven and arranged all things into a great and final tem ptation, and he overc ame in it completely . He fulfilled the purpose of the Divine itself . He gave the promise of regeneration to the most ancient celest ial perception and restored it to the understanding illumin ated by wisdom — the vessel that carries the light of truth on ward.

**¶7:** The fifth combat is that which Divine Providence itself wages — which is the calling forth of truth and its reception in the will. It is the greatest of all, and it placed its domin ion upon every state , over coming spiritual death, which had ruled alongside evil . And it was victorious over spiritual death forever , and it best owed the heav enly kingdom — the eternal reign of good con joined with truth.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The sons of light waged five wars against the sons of darkness. The sons of light humiliated the sons of darkness in them all.

The first war is that of the First living Man, which he waged against the King of the realms of Darkness, and all the rulers that had come forth from the five worlds of [darkness]. He hunted them with his net, which is the living soul. He [trapped them] in the snare and [revealed] the face of the [light,] his virgin, the living fire[, and] they did not find how to escape his net[. And] he caught them like fish [by means of] the five counsels of the five elements [of light]. He cut and dug out the root of the five trees, [the very] root of the evil tree, like an axe.

The fourth war is this that Jesus the glorious one waged against all the rebels who had rebelled above and below. When the light was purified from them by the image of the Third Ambassador, their chains loosened [and they rose up in open rebellion]. The glorious one in the fourth war; he came and brought [to an end] a rebellion of the entire ruling-power. He girded himself [with power and confronted] all of it another time. He constructed the whole structure and he made [of it] a great contest; he humiliated therein. [And] he fulfilled the will of the greatness, [he gave the] hope to Adam [and guided him] to his light ship.
[Thus] the good are victorious over the wicked [and shall reign] for ever and ever.
This is what the ruling-power is like [in its greed], all riches [ it seizes] as they travel [ toward the] light [above]. He cleansed and purified it.

The second war is that of the Living Spirit [...]. He has constructed the things and the worlds of light; he spread out the rulers and chained them in the middle [...] the stars in [...] the earths [...] them in the three vessels. For the rulers rebelled and were set against the Living Spirit. They wished to [...] since they knew and realised that he might bind and fetter them with a strong chain. Yet he, the Living Spirit, (appeared to them) with many aspects, with numerous [...], with many hands and great cruelties. He was revealed to them, he imprisoned them with much skill. Not one of them was able to save (himself), and he [...] [...]. Now, since he [...] he trapped them [...] [...].

fills.fill: and they rose up in open rebellion
